_about: Fixed benchmark set for the daily MCP self-improvement engine (scripts/engine-bench.mjs, graded by lib/engine-grade.mjs). Change a question only in its own PR: a question edit resets that row's day-over-day diff. Fields: id (stable, never reused), set (cross_domain | colocation), intent (sent verbatim to execute_plan, detail compact, keyless), place_groups (each group needs one hit in the lead), open_places_min (distinct US places from the grader's list the lead must name, for 'where' questions), sides (dc and/or energy: each needs a sentence in the lead with that side's words and a figure), require_figure (default true), classes / not_classes (intent_class routing).

questions.intent: Where in the US can I get 50 MW of data center capacity powered within 24 months, and what will power cost?
For a 100 MW data center in Northern Virginia, what is the power situation in PJM, what does power cost, and how many data centers are already there?
Compare Dallas and Phoenix for a 50 MW AI campus: data center supply, grid headroom and power prices.
How soon can a 100 MW load get power in ERCOT, and which Texas metros already have the most data center capacity?
What are electricity prices and data center vacancy like in Chicago right now?
Rank US markets for a 200 MW AI training campus by power availability and existing data center ecosystem.
Is Columbus, Ohio a good place for a 60 MW data center given AEP's grid constraints and local data center supply?
How does the Atlanta data center market look for a 30 MW deployment, and what are Georgia Power grid and price conditions?
Colocation options in Ashburn for 500 kW
Which colocation providers have the most data center capacity in Dallas?
What does colocation cost in Northern Virginia per kW per month?
Compare Equinix DC11 in Ashburn and CyrusOne Sterling for a 1 MW deployment
Find 2 MW of colocation in Chicago available in 2027
Best carrier-neutral colocation in Atlanta with strong peering
Colocation in Phoenix for 300 kW, and what is the local power cost?
Which Silicon Valley colocation facilities could take a 750 kW deployment?

_governance: Rules (owner decision 5, 2026-11-18): (1) ids are permanent: a question is never edited in place; change its wording by retiring the id (move it to retired with the date and reason) and adding a new id, so the day-over-day diff never compares two different questions. (2) a retired id is never reused. (3) add or retire questions only in a PR the owner merges; Brain may draft it. (4) outside head-to-head questions (Grok's set) come in verbatim with an id prefix g, set cross_domain or colocation. (5) keep the run at or under MAX_CALLS in scripts/engine-bench.mjs. test/engine-grade.test.mjs enforces 1, 2 and 5.
